title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or those without assigned roles, to access uploaded bank statement file contents without proper permission checks. Attackers can craft requests to read files outside their authorized scope.
